issues.description: The UML in the problem statement declares Farm.addAnimal(animal: Animal): boolean, but the solution implements addAnimal as void (public void addAnimal(Animal animal)) and the template does not provide a signature. This creates ambiguity for students about the intended return type of addAnimal and may lead to inconsistent implementations.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across artifacts. Either: (A) change the UML and problem text to declare addAnimal(animal: Animal): void to match the solution, or (B) change the solution (and template helper signatures) so addAnimal returns boolean (e.g., return true when the animal was added). Update all references (UML, problem description, template stub) accordingly so students have a single unambiguous signature to implement.
